states.name: engaged
states.description: User is actively following the rehabilitation interaction.

states.name: neutral
states.description: No obvious positive or negative state signal.

states.name: confused
states.description: User may not understand the instruction or task goal.

states.name: fatigued
states.description: User shows fatigue or decreasing interaction energy.

states.name: frustrated
states.description: User shows frustration, resistance, or negative engagement.

states.name: discomfort
states.description: User may feel pain or physical discomfort.

states.name: low_attention
states.description: User attention is low or drifting away from the task.

states.name: need_help
states.description: User appears to need external assistance.
